title: The Cold War ends: January 1990
oneLine: The Berlin Wall has fallen, Eastern Europe has thrown off communism and Gorbachev's Soviet Union is starting to come apart. Nobody knows what comes next.

whoIsWho.stance: Wants to save the Soviet Union by reforming it, and will not use tanks abroad.
Cautious: backs German unity inside NATO and avoids gloating over Moscow.
Pushes to reunite Germany as fast as possible.
Close to Bush, wary of a big united Germany.
Deep in war debts and angry at Kuwait and the Gulf states over oil prices.
About to free Mandela and negotiate an end to apartheid.

whyItMatters: For 40 years the world was split in two. Now the old order is collapsing fast and mostly peacefully, but no one knows what replaces it: a united Germany, a broken-up Soviet Union, and new wars in places the superpowers used to hold down.

timeline.text: Mikhail Gorbachev becomes Soviet leader and starts reforms.
The first intifada begins in Gaza and the West Bank.
A ceasefire ends the eight-year Iran-Iraq War.
The last Soviet troops leave Afghanistan.
China's army crushes the protests in Tiananmen Square.
Communist rule collapses in Czechoslovakia and Romania.
US forces invade Panama to remove Manuel Noriega.
